tokyo_et_vous.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Course prices are from the shop's own lunch/dinner pages and are stated 税別 (BEFORE 10% tax); add ~10% at the till. Checked 2026-08-20. Dish compositions are the shop's own 一例 (sample line-up) — the actual plates change with the season.

items.en: Casual lunch course — hors d'oeuvre, then either potage or pasta, then a main you choose from the prix-fixe list
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Prix-fixe: you pick the main. The pasta option and the bread are wheat; French sauces here are flour-thickened. Say 小麦アレルギー when booking.

items.en: Light lunch course — hors d'oeuvre, fish of the day, a main of your choice, dessert
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Fish and meat throughout; French sauces normally contain flour and butter.

items.en: Special lunch course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, potage, fish, a main of your choice, dessert
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. The published sample hors d'oeuvre plate explicitly names セモリナ小麦 (durum semolina) and クスクス (couscous) — both wheat.

items.ja: 大切な方との特別な日のコース
items.romaji: taisetsu na kata to no tokubetsu na hi no course
items.en: Special-occasion course (birthdays, anniversaries) — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. プティフール (petits fours) are baked wheat sweets.

items.en: Today's dessert with coffee or tea (lunch add-on)
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Dessert changes daily; the shop's sample is クレームダンジュ (crémet d'Anjou — whipped fresh cheese), so dairy at minimum.

items.en: Light dinner course — hors d'oeuvre, fish of the day, a meat main of your choice, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. All dinner courses are prix-fixe on the meat.

items.en: Standard dinner course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, potage, fish of the day, meat main of your choice, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Some mains carry a supplement — see the meat list below.

items.en: Special dinner course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat main, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別.

items.en: EDO Cuisine course — the chef's Edo-Tokyo-meets-France menu: hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours. Signatures include 江戸前ぬた (fish and greens in vinegared miso) and steak glazed with 江戸甘味噌 sweet Edo miso
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. 江戸甘味噌 and ぬた are miso preparations whose grain base is not declared, and the glazes use soy. Treat as wheat-containing.

items.ja: 旨味たっぷり地鶏もも肉のロティ エシャロットソース
items.romaji: jidori momoniku no roti, échalote sauce
items.en: Roast free-range chicken thigh with shallot sauce — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Roast chicken is naturally wheat-free but the shallot pan sauce is a classic reduction; ask whether flour or soy goes in.

items.ja: 特選豚ロース肉のロースト 万久さんの味噌風味
items.romaji: tokusen buta rosu no roast, Mankyu-san no miso fumi
items.en: Roast selected pork loin finished with Mankyu's miso — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Miso finish with the grain base undeclared, and glazes of this kind normally carry soy sauce. Treat as wheat.

items.en: Selected beef steak — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Plain grilled beef; the sauce is the risk. The EDO Cuisine version is glazed with 江戸甘味噌.

items.ja: 仔羊のロースト 香味風味
items.en: Roast lamb with aromatics, seasonal vegetables and shallot sauce
items.note: Ask about the crust — French roast lamb is very often finished with a breadcrumb-herb crust.

items.ja: トロトロ和牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮込み
items.en: Wagyu beef cheek braised in red wine until it collapses
items.note: A red-wine braise is thickened with roux or a flour-dusted sear in nearly every French kitchen; assume wheat unless the chef says otherwise.

items.ja: 特選和牛肉のロースト／グリエ
items.en: Roast or grilled selected wagyu — the top main choice
items.note: The shop states the supplement differs by course.

items.ja: 北海道産メークインとセモリナ小麦・ワイルドライスのクリームグラタン
items.romaji: Hokkaido May Queen to semorina komugi, wild rice no cream gratin
items.en: Cream gratin of Hokkaido May Queen potato, semolina wheat and wild rice — a published sample hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: The shop's own text names セモリナ小麦 — durum wheat semolina. Explicit wheat, plus dairy cream.

items.ja: ひよこ豆とクスクスのタブレ
items.en: Chickpea and couscous taboulé — a published sample hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: クスクス is durum wheat. Otherwise plant-based; ask about the dressing.

items.ja: 小松菜とほうれん草のスムージー
items.en: Komatsuna and spinach smoothie — a published sample hors d'oeuvre item
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Greens as listed, but the shop does not say whether dairy or honey goes in. Ask.

items.ja: 自家製スモークサーモンとギリシャ風ピクルス〜白胡麻と豆腐のソース
items.romaji: jikasei smoked salmon to Girisha-fu pickles, shirogoma to tofu no sauce
items.en: House-smoked salmon with Greek-style pickles in a white-sesame-and-tofu sauce — a published sample dinner hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: The sauce is tofu and sesame rather than dairy — worth knowing if you avoid milk — but the cure and pickle liquor may carry soy sauce. Fish, so not vegan.

items.ja: クロダイと北海道産ホタテのポワレ 菜花のソース
items.romaji: kurodai to Hokkaido hotate no poêlé, nanohana no sauce
items.en: Pan-seared black sea bream and Hokkaido scallop with oven-roasted hakusai and maitake, rape-blossom sauce — a published sample fish course
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Poêlé fish is frequently floured before searing. Ask.

items.ja: クレームダンジュ〜ココナッツソース
items.en: Crémet d'Anjou — whipped fresh cheese and cream — with coconut sauce; a published sample dessert
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Fresh cheese and cream. Often plated on a biscuit or with a tuile — ask for it without.

items.ja: チョコレートのムース、赤葡萄のシャーベット〜木苺のソース仕立て
items.romaji: chocolate mousse, akabudou no sherbet, kiichigo sauce
items.en: Chocolate mousse with red-grape sorbet and raspberry sauce — a published sample dinner dessert
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Mousse is egg- and cream-based.

items.en: Macchiato (hot only) — espresso marked with a spoon of milk foam

items.en: Brûlée latte — a latte with a torched caramelised sugar crust, hot or iced

items.en: Cocoa, hot or iced

items.en: Apple juice
items.note: Bottled juice; brand not stated.

Ginger ale
Cola

items.ja: ハチミツレモンスカッシュ
items.en: Sparkling honey-lemon squash

items.en: Chai, hot or iced

items.en: Matcha latte, hot or iced
items.note: Café matcha is usually a pre-sweetened blend of undeclared composition; dairy milk.

items.en: Beer and other alcohol

items.ja: 季節のフルーツサンド

items.en: Seasonal toast
items.note: Wheat bread.

items.en: Banana roll — a whole banana rolled in sponge with cream
items.note: Sponge is wheat flour and egg; cream is dairy.

items.en: Cookie
items.note: Wheat flour and butter.

items.en: Scone
items.note: Wheat flour, butter, milk.

items.en: Custard pudding
items.note: Egg, milk and sugar — usually no wheat in the custard itself, but a garnish biscuit is common. Ask for it plain.

items.en: Affogato — espresso poured over ice cream
items.note: Dairy ice cream; ask whether a wafer comes with it.

items.en: Chef's-whim sweet — whatever has been made that day

items.en: Set discount — order any food or sweet with a drink and the drink is ¥100 less

items.ja: イングリッシュ・ブレックファスト
items.en: English Breakfast — two fried eggs, house sausage and bacon, grilled tomato, greens, mushrooms, baked beans and toast, all in the pan
items.section: BREKKIE 朝ごはん (8:00–11:00, also on the all-day PLATES sheet)
items.note: Toast is wheat; house sausages are almost always rusk-bound; baked-bean sauce commonly carries wheat starch. Meat and egg.

items.en: Avocado toast on honey-quinoa bread with ripe avocado, dukkah spice, a poached egg and honey
items.note: ハニーキヌアブレッド is a wheat loaf with quinoa in it, not a quinoa-only bread. Egg and honey.

items.ja: 自家製グラノーラとフルーツのボウル
items.romaji: jikasei granola to fruits no bowl
items.en: House granola and fruit bowl with your choice of yoghurt or milk
items.note: House granola — oats are frequently milled alongside wheat and many granolas add barley malt; ask. Comes with dairy either way.

items.ja: モーニングセット（生ハムとモッツァレラ、ほうれん草のパニーニ＆チリビーンズスープ）
items.romaji: morning set — panini to chili bean soup
items.en: Morning set — prosciutto, mozzarella and spinach panini with chilli-bean soup, drip coffee included
items.note: Panini bread is wheat.

items.ja: 助六フレンチトースト
items.en: SUKE6 French toast on rye campagne — limited quantity daily
items.note: Rye campagne in a Japanese bakery is a rye-and-wheat loaf, and rye itself contains gluten. Egg and milk custard. Add-ons: natural ice cream +¥400, maple syrup +¥200, house jam +¥200.

items.en: One boiled egg — tell them how you want it done
items.note: A boiled egg in the shell: no wheat can reach it, and it is cooked in water not in the shared fryer. This is the safest hot item on the menu.

items.ja: 目玉焼き・スクランブル等（卵2個）
items.en: Two eggs fried your way — sunny side up, over easy, scrambled
items.note: Eggs and butter only, but cooked on the same flat-top as the bread and paninis. Ask for a clean pan if you are coeliac.

items.ja: クリーミーなオムレツ（卵3個）
items.en: Creamy plain omelette, three eggs
items.note: Add ham ¥150, cheese ¥150 or mushroom ¥200. Plain omelette has no wheat ingredient; shared cooktop.

items.en: Green salad (side)
items.note: The dressing is house-made and undeclared — Japanese house dressings very often contain soy sauce. Ask for oil and salt.

items.en: Roasted potato (side)
items.note: Roasted rather than deep-fried, so it avoids the shared fryer, but confirm the tray is not shared with breaded items.

items.en: Sautéed spinach (side)
items.note: Ask whether butter is used.

items.ja: 八幡平ジオファームのマッシュルームソテー
items.en: Sautéed Hachimantai Geo Farm mushrooms (side)
items.note: Named single-farm mushrooms. Ask about butter and whether soy sauce is used to finish.

items.en: Fried tomato (side)
Avocado (side)
items.note: Cut raw avocado — nothing added, nothing cooked.

items.ja: 自家製スモークベーコン
items.en: House-smoked bacon (side)
items.note: House cure of undeclared composition; cured meats in Japan often carry soy or wheat in the brine.

items.en: Smoked salmon (side)

items.ja: 助六スマッシュバーガー
items.en: SUKE6 smash burger — Australian barley-fed beef patty on a brioche bun with grilled onion, tomato and house chipotle mayo, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Brioche bun is wheat. Add cheese +¥250, bacon +¥350, avocado +¥300, a second beef patty +¥550. The shop announced a reworked burger recipe on 2026-07-21.

items.ja: ヴィーガン・グリルド・ケサディーヤ
items.en: Vegan grilled quesadilla — tortilla with vegan chilli beans, tomato, plenty of avocado, lettuce and red onion, with salad
items.note: The shop's own text calls it ビーガン and the beans ビーガンチリビーンズ. Wheat tortilla, so not gluten-free. If you add the optional cheese (+¥250) it stops being vegan.

items.ja: ベジタリアンチリビーンズ
items.en: Vegetarian chilli beans (snack portion)
items.note: The same beans the shop labels ビーガンチリビーンズ inside its vegan quesadilla, so plant-based by the shop's own wording. Ask about the spice blend if you need it wheat-free.

items.ja: フムスと野菜プレート
items.en: Hummus and vegetable plate with olives, vegetables and pickles, dusted with dukkah
items.note: Hummus and vegetables are plant-based, but dukkah blends sometimes include wheat crumb and pita often comes alongside. Ask for it without bread.

items.en: Niçoise salad — grilled Misaki tuna confit, soft-boiled egg, anchovy and greens
items.note: Egg and fish. The dressing is undeclared; anchovy pastes sometimes carry wheat.

items.en: Assorted house charcuterie
items.note: The kitchen makes its own hams and sausages; composition not published.

items.en: Marinated salmon
House pickles
items.note: Vinegar pickles; ask whether the liquor contains soy sauce.

items.ja: オリーブとドライトマトマリネ
items.en: Marinated olives and dried tomato
items.note: Olives, dried tomato and oil — no wheat ingredient and no animal product in any of the three.

items.en: Fried potato
items.note: Deep-fried in a fryer shared with breaded items in a bakery-attached kitchen — the classic cross-contamination trap. Plant-based but not safe for coeliacs.

items.ja: ギリシャ風チキンピタ ヨーグルトソース
items.en: Greek chicken gyros — house-made fluffy pita with garlic-and-oregano marinated chicken, red onion, cucumber, tomato and yoghurt sauce, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: House pita is wheat; yoghurt is dairy.

items.ja: キューバンサンドイッチ 助六風
items.en: Cubano — soft bun with house pulled pork, prosciutto cotto, white cheese and pineapple tropical relish, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Wheat bun.

items.ja: カレー風味の国産生ソーセージホットドッグ
items.en: Asakusa Hot Dog! — domestic fresh salsiccia in a whole-wheat roll with curry-flavoured cabbage and onion fries, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Whole-wheat roll, plus curry powder and onion fries — several wheat routes at once.

items.ja: スパイシーなモロッコ風メルゲーズ オープンサンドイッチ
items.en: Moroccan merguez open sandwich — merguez sausage, chilli, spring onion and tomato on campagne bread
items.note: Campagne bread is wheat. Scrambled egg on top +¥300.

items.ja: キュウリと海苔のサンドイッチ
items.en: Cucumber and seaweed sandwich — cheese, sesame sauce and grain loaf, with salad and roasted potatoes; the shop admits it sounds odd and says the secret is sesame paste and soy sauce
items.note: Grain loaf is wheat AND the shop names お醤油 (soy sauce) in the sauce — wheat twice over. Cheese is dairy.

items.en: Croissant, baked by MANUFACTURE on the third floor

items.en: Pain au chocolat
items.note: Wheat and butter.

items.en: Bagel
items.note: Wheat.

items.en: English bread — a slice of tin loaf, toasted or as it comes
items.note: Wheat.

items.ja: ライ麦のカンパーニュ スライス
items.en: Rye campagne, sliced

items.ja: イングリッシュマフィン
items.en: English muffin
items.note: Wheat.

items.en: Biscuit (American-style)
items.note: Wheat and butter.

items.en: Waffle

items.en: Caramel pudding

items.ja: 抹茶のシフォンケーキ

items.en: Gâteau au chocolat

items.ja: 焼きドーナツ バニラアイス添え

items.en: Baked doughnut with vanilla ice cream
items.note: Wheat.

items.ja: 本日のナチュラルアイスクリーム
items.en: Today's natural ice cream, from KIKI Natural Ice Cream
items.note: Flavour changes daily; dairy.

items.en: Espresso

items.en: Café latte, hot or iced

items.ja: エスプレッソ・トニック

items.note: Espresso over tonic water.

items.en: House ginger ale — organic Shimanto ginger with organic Kikaijima cane sugar, hot or iced
items.note: The shop names both ingredients and their farms; ginger, cane sugar and water, nothing malted.

items.en: House tomato juice
Fresh-squeezed juice

items.ja: キューカンバー・モヒート（ノンアルコール）
items.en: Cucumber mojito, alcohol-free

Oriol Rossel Brut cava, Spanish sparkling

items.ja: シズラー プレミアムサラダバー
items.en: The Premium Salad Bar on its own — 70-plus items, unlimited refills: seasonal vegetables, deli salads, soups, fruit, pasta, tacos, desserts and soft drinks. Comes with the cheese toast
items.note: This is the reason to come, and it is also a buffet: shared tongs across 70 trays, pasta and tacos in the line, soy-based dressings. There is plenty a vegan can eat but nothing a coeliac should trust. The chain says an アレルギー物質一覧表 (allergen table) is kept at the store — ask for it at the door.

items.en: Salad bar, ages 3–6
items.note: Same buffet, child price. Same buffet caveats.

items.ja: チャイルドサラダバー（7〜12歳）
items.en: Salad bar, ages 7–12

items.ja: シニアサラダバー（65歳以上）
items.en: Salad bar, 65 and over
items.note: Bring ID; the weekday-lunch senior rate is notably cheaper.

items.ja: シズラーチーズトースト
items.en: Sizzler Cheese Toast — thick-cut bread spread with parmesan and griddled to golden brown. The 50-year-old American recipe the chain is famous for; it comes free with every salad bar
items.price: サラダバーに付属（ランチエクスプレスのみ1枚 ¥84／税込 ¥92）
items.section: シズラーチーズトースト Cheese Toast
items.note: Wheat bread and parmesan. The single most-photographed item here and completely off-limits gluten-free.

items.en: Lunch Express — weekday-only cut-price salad bar: two plates plus one dessert cup, unlimited drinks and soup
items.note: The chain states the cheese toast is NOT included in this one — it is ¥84 (税込 ¥92) a slice. Two plates only, so plan them.

items.ja: モーニングビュッフェ（新宿東宝ビル店限定）
items.en: Breakfast Buffet — this branch only, 6:30–10:30 (last admission 10:00, stay until 10:30). Cheese toast is griddled to order and free, but you have to ask for it
items.note: A Kabukicho hotel breakfast buffet in the Hotel Gracery building. Same shared-tongs problem as the day buffet.

items.en: Ribeye steak 150g — Australian beef delivered chilled and cut by hand in-store, seared hot. Salad bar for one included
items.note: The beef itself is plain grilled, but you pick a sauce — of the five offered only ミントソース (yoghurt and mint) and the plain steak avoid an obvious wheat route. わさび醤油 is soy sauce, i.e. wheat; ドミグラス (demi-glace) is a flour-based brown sauce; グリーンチリペッパーソース is built on gravy. Ask for it sauceless.

items.en: Ribeye steak 300g, salad bar included
items.note: Gram weights are pre-cooking. Same sauce caveat.

items.en: Ribeye steak 450g — a full pound, an inch thick, salad bar included
items.note: Same sauce caveat.

items.ja: シズラーハンバーグステーキ
items.en: Hamburger steak — 100% beef patty served spitting on a hot iron plate, salad bar included
items.note: Japanese ハンバーグ is bound with panko breadcrumb and is served under a demi-glace; assume wheat in both the patty and the sauce.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆シュリンプグリル
items.en: Hamburger steak with four grilled prawns, salad bar included
items.note: Patty binder as above. Pick two sauces.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆ロブスター
items.en: Hamburger steak with lobster, salad bar included

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆BBQポークスペアリブ 2P
items.romaji: hamburger steak & BBQ pork spare ribs 2P
items.en: Hamburger steak with two BBQ-glazed pork spare ribs, salad bar included
items.note: The chain flags that the BBQ sauce contains honey (so not vegan either); BBQ sauces are also a standard soy-sauce and wheat-starch vehicle.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆リブロースステーキ150g
items.en: Hamburger steak plus a 150g ribeye — the beef-lover's combo, salad bar included

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆ラムチョップグリル
items.en: Hamburger steak with grilled Australian lamb chops, salad bar included
items.note: Mint sauce is the recommended pairing and is the one flour-free sauce on the board.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆ロブスター
items.en: Ribeye 150g with lobster, salad bar included
items.note: You choose two sauces — see the sauce note on the plain ribeye.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆牡蠣と帆立貝柱のグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with four steamed oysters and four Hokkaido scallops, salad bar included

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆シュリンプグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with four grilled prawns, salad bar included

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆サーモンのグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with grilled fatty salmon, salad bar included

items.ja: サンタフェチキン＆マリブチキン
items.en: Sizzler Classics — Santa Fe chicken (Mitsuse chicken marinated in chilli, coriander and lime, grilled) alongside Malibu chicken (breaded fried chicken topped with ham and cheese), a recipe as old as the chain
items.note: マリブチキン is 衣をつけてフライした — battered and deep-fried, so wheat in the coating and a shared fryer. The Santa Fe half alone would be a better bet, but they arrive on one plate.

items.ja: サンタフェチキン＆ポップコーンシュリンプ
items.en: Santa Fe chicken with popcorn shrimp
items.note: Popcorn shrimp is battered and fried.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆マリブチキン
items.en: Ribeye 150g with Malibu chicken — Sizzler USA's long-running seller
items.note: Breaded chicken.

items.ja: みつせ鶏もも肉のグリル
items.en: Grilled chicken thigh — Mitsuse chicken raised in the mountains of northern Kyushu, delivered chilled, served with grilled lemon and fresh salsa
items.price: 平日ランチ ランチグリルセット ¥2,220 (税込 ¥2,442) / 1tripサラダバー付 ¥3,080 (税込 ¥3,388) / サラダバー1名付 ¥4,010 (税込 ¥4,411)
items.section: LUNCH PICK-UP GRILLS 平日ランチ (11:00–15:00)
items.note: Grilled, not breaded, and dressed with salsa rather than a brown sauce — the most plausible gluten-free main in the building, but confirm the marinade.

items.ja: シーフードプラッター
items.en: Seafood platter — one lobster, four prawns, four Hokkaido scallops and four steamed oysters, salad bar included
items.note: All grilled or steamed rather than fried; the butter sauces are the thing to query.

items.ja: シズリング ケイジャンシュリンプグリル
items.en: Sizzling Cajun grilled shrimp — six prawns spitting in Cajun spice
items.note: Cajun spice blends occasionally use wheat flour as a carrier. Ask.

items.ja: 牡蠣と帆立貝柱のグリル＆シュリンプのグリル
items.en: Four steamed oysters, four Hokkaido scallops and four prawns, all grilled, salad bar included
Grilled salmon with fresh salsa, salad bar included
items.note: Salsa rather than a flour sauce — a reasonable ask-and-order.

items.ja: チキン＆シュリンプファヒータ
items.en: Chicken and shrimp fajitas — grilled in Mexican spice with peppers and onion, four tortillas, with salsa, avocado dip, sour cream, coriander and lime
items.note: Fajita tortillas in Japan are wheat flour tortillas, not corn. Sour cream is dairy.

items.ja: ビーフ＆シュリンプファヒータ
items.en: Beef and shrimp fajitas, four tortillas with the same toppings
items.note: Wheat tortillas.

items.ja: ポップコーンシュリンプ
items.en: Popcorn shrimp — bite-size battered prawns, faintly spicy on the finish
items.note: Battered and deep-fried. The chain notes appetizers can only be ordered alongside a grill or the salad bar.

items.ja: フライドポテト〜トリュフソルト＆パルミジャーノ・レッジャーノ〜
items.romaji: fried potato — truffle salt & Parmigiano Reggiano
items.en: French fries with truffle salt and Parmigiano Reggiano grated to order (plain fries ¥650 / 税込 ¥715)
items.note: The chain prints 揚げ油は使い分けておりません — the frying oil is NOT separated between items. Everything from this fryer is cross-contaminated with the breaded chicken and shrimp. Parmesan is dairy.

items.ja: ソフトシェルシュリンプ
items.en: Fried soft-shell shrimp — caught just after moulting, so the shell is soft enough to eat whole
items.note: Deep-fried in the shared oil.

items.en: Orange chicken — American-Chinese fried chicken in a sweet-tart orange sauce
items.note: Battered, fried, and the orange sauce is soy-and-cornstarch based.

items.ja: 追加：リブロースステーキ150g／BBQポークスペアリブ1P／ラムチョップグリル1P
items.romaji: add on — ribeye 150g / BBQ pork spare rib 1P / grilled lamb cutlet 1P
items.en: Add-ons to any grill: ribeye 150g ¥1,920 (税込 ¥2,112), one BBQ pork spare rib ¥830 (税込 ¥913), one grilled lamb cutlet ¥1,390 (税込 ¥1,529)
items.note: The BBQ rib's sauce contains honey by the chain's own note.

items.ja: 追加：ロブスター／牡蠣と帆立貝柱／シュリンプグリル
items.romaji: add on — lobster / oysters & scallops / grilled shrimp
items.en: Seafood add-ons: lobster ¥2,130 (税込 ¥2,343), grilled oysters and scallops ¥1,970 (税込 ¥2,167), grilled shrimp ¥1,260 (税込 ¥1,386)

items.ja: ランチグリルセット／1tripサラダバー／サラダバー1名様付き
items.romaji: lunch grill set / 1 trip salad bar / salad bar for one
items.en: Weekday lunch structures: ランチグリルセット is the grill with one soup, two drinks and rice or bread; 1trip サラダバー adds one plate one visit to the bar for +¥860 (税込 ¥946); サラダバー1名様付き gives the full bar plus cheese toast for +¥1,790 (税込 ¥1,969)
items.note: Only the full サラダバー付き option includes the cheese toast; the 1-trip option does not.

items.ja: ソース各種（ドミグラス／グリーンチリペッパー／ベアルネーズ／ミント／わさび醤油）
items.romaji: sauces — demi-glace / green chili pepper / béarnaise / mint / wasabi-shoyu
items.en: Choose your steak sauce, no charge: demi-glace, green chilli pepper (a gravy base with green chilli and mustard), béarnaise (butter and herb), mint (mint in yoghurt), or wasabi-soy. Potato on the side: mashed, baked or fries
items.note: わさび醤油 is wheat soy sauce — flatly not gluten-free. ドミグラス is a flour-thickened brown sauce and グリーンチリペッパー is built on gravy, so both are suspect. ミントソース (yoghurt) and ベアルネーズ (egg and butter) are the two with no obvious wheat route, but all five are dairy or egg or soy — none is vegan.

items.ja: ハートランド生ビール
items.en: Heartland draft beer, by the glass or the pitcher
items.note: Barley beer — never gluten-free. Kirin Ichibanshibori 500ml bottle ¥730 (税込 ¥803); Heineken 330ml ¥690 (税込 ¥759).

items.ja: キリン グリーンズフリー
items.en: Kirin Greens Free — alcohol-free beer-taste drink, three hops, 334ml bottle
items.note: Alcohol-free but still a malt-and-hops beverage. Not gluten-free.

items.ja: ハウスワイン テヌータ・サン・マルコ（赤・白）
items.romaji: house wine — Tenuta San Marco (red / white)
items.en: House wine from Cantine Due Palme: red is a Salento Negroamaro (medium body, red-fruit nose, firm tannin), white a Salento Malvasia (dry, citrus and white flowers)
items.note: Grape wine — no grain. Fining agents may be animal-derived, which is the only vegan question.

items.en: Bottle list: Robert Mondavi Woodbridge Pinot Noir ¥3,130 (税込 ¥3,443), Casillero del Diablo Sauvignon Blanc ¥3,130, Mondavi Private Selection Bourbon-Barrel Cabernet ¥5,130 (税込 ¥5,643), Mondavi Private Selection Vint Chardonnay ¥4,130 (税込 ¥4,543), Château Reysson Bordeaux ¥3,730 (税込 ¥4,103), Capetta Brut Spumante ¥2,280 (税込 ¥2,508)
items.note: The bourbon-barrel Cabernet is aged in whiskey wood but is still grape wine.

items.en: Two-hour free-flow plan — Heartland draft, Heineken, house wine, sparkling wine, plus the non-alcoholic Greens Free, MOCK Bar and zero-alcohol sparkling
items.note: Beer is in the plan, so the plan as a whole is not gluten-free even though the wines are. Everyone at the table must order it (children excepted); last orders five minutes before time.

items.ja: モクバル／スパークリング アルコールゼロ
items.romaji: MOCK Bar / Sparkling Wine Non Alcohol
items.en: MOCK Bar mocktails (pear-and-pine or orange-and-mango mix, 250ml) and alcohol-free sparkling in white or rosé (360ml)
items.note: Fruit and de-alcoholised grape — unlike the non-alcoholic beer, these carry no malt. Soft drinks otherwise live on the salad bar and are included with it.

tokyo_yugyoan_tankuma_kitamise.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. All from the restaurant's own 東京ドームホテル店 page, every figure marked (税・サ込) — tax AND service already included, which is unusual and means the printed number is the number. Course compositions are the 8/1–8/31 2026 seasonal line-up and rotate monthly. Checked 2026-08-20. Four kitchens share one floor (Japanese/kaiseki, teppanyaki, tempura, sushi) and each has its own list.

items.en: Japanese breakfast set — small dish, simmered dish, grilled fish, toasted nori, pickles, miso soup, rice, and yoghurt with fruit. Served 7:00–10:30, last entry 10:00
items.section: 和食ダイニング 朝食 Breakfast (7:00–10:30)
items.note: 焼肴 and 焚合 are simmered/glazed in soy; the nori is normally 味付け (soy-seasoned). Fish and dairy.

items.en: Kyoto-style morning rice porridge — small dish, simmered dish, grilled fish, pickles, miso soup, plain white congee with a Yoshino-kudzu bekko sauce, sardines, and yoghurt with fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 朝食 Breakfast (7:00–10:30)
items.note: The congee itself is rice and water and the 吉野葛 thickener is kudzu starch, not wheat — but the べっこあん is a soy-seasoned sauce and the 焼肴 is glazed. Ask for the congee plain.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ランチ御膳「古都」
items.en: Koto lunch set — today's small dish, two sashimi, seasonal tempura assortment, fresh yuba with salmon roe, salmon-and-edamame rice, Kyoto Yamari red miso soup, pickles
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 天ぷら is wheat batter and the sashimi comes with soy. Add-ons: coffee/tea +¥500, three seasonal fruits +¥850, chawanmushi +¥1,000, grilled fish +¥1,800, wagyu fillet steak +¥5,000, salt-grilled Lake Biwa baby ayu (2) +¥2,000, conger steamed in yuba +¥1,500, matsutake-and-hamo dobin-mushi +¥3,500.

items.en: Hamo hari-hari hotpot set — seasonal appetiser, pike conger in nanban marinade, two sashimi, salt-grilled greenling, then the pot itself: hamo rolled in yuba with mizuna, sasa-negi, tofu, carrot, daikon and shiitake. Rice, miso, pickles. Summer only, 1 June–31 Aug
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 南蛮漬け and the hotpot broth are both soy-based; 湯葉 itself is fine but everything it sits in is not. Hamo (pike conger) is the Kyoto summer fish — worth ordering if you have never had it.

items.ja: 熊魚菴季節のおまかせランチ「彩」
items.en: Sai omakase lunch — seven-part appetiser (fig in sesame vinegar, bayberry in syrup, Yoshino-style shrimp, vegetable omelette, sweet potato, okra-and-smoked-duck skewer, corn shinjo), matsutake and fish-dumpling clear soup with junsai, thin-sliced sea bream, salt-grilled greenling, hamo yanagawa hotpot, salmon-edamame rice, red miso, three pickles, fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 擬製玉子 is egg; 真蒸 (shinjo) fish dumplings are bound with starch and often wheat; yanagawa is a soy-and-egg simmer. Dashi throughout.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ランチ贅沢コース「洛」
items.en: Raku luxury lunch — the same seven appetisers, then the house-signature suppon (soft-shell turtle) hotpot with tofu, grilled mochi and negi; sea bream, bluefin and surf clam sashimi; tempura of a wild tiger prawn with three seasonal vegetables; Kyoto beef roast beef; salmon-edamame rice, red miso, pickles, melon and fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Tempura is wheat. 焼餅 is glutinous rice, which despite the English name contains no gluten — but it sits in a soy broth.

items.en: Summer eel mini kaiseki, served in four passes — sesame tofu and unagi-zaku; eel chawanmushi; a two-tier box of two sashimi over a whole grilled eel kabayaki with three pickles; liver clear soup; dessert. Lunch and dinner, 1–31 August only
items.section: 和食ダイニング 季節限定 Seasonal (Aug 2026)
items.note: 蒲焼 glaze is soy and mirin — wheat. And the shop's own English says the soup contains WHEAT GLUTEN: 巻麩 is 麩, pure gluten. Two separate hard nos in one course.

items.en: Kyotoryoen — a summer-only course with a choice of main and two hours of free-flow drinks (draft and bottled beer, sake, red and white wine, sweet-potato and barley shochu, whisky, lemon sour, plum wine, soft drinks). 1 July–31 Aug
items.price: ¥13,000（＋¥2,000 to upgrade to champagne and premium sake）
items.section: 和食ダイニング 季節限定 Seasonal (Aug 2026)
items.note: The free-flow list explicitly includes beer and 麦焼酎 — barley in both. If you need gluten-free, the sake and the sweet-potato shochu in the same plan are the safe halves.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ディナー御膳「京」
items.en: Kyo dinner set — sesame tofu to start, two of today's sashimi, the house-famous silver cod grilled in Saikyo miso, chawanmushi, rice, miso and pickles
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: 銀鱈西京焼き is cod marinated in Saikyo sweet white miso — the miso's grain base is not declared, and the marinade normally carries mirin and sake. Chawanmushi's dashi is bonito. Same add-on list as the Koto lunch.

items.ja: ディナーステーキ御膳「雅」
items.en: Miyabi steak dinner set — sesame tofu, three sashimi, domestic beef fillet steak, fresh yuba with salmon roe, chawanmushi, salmon-edamame rice
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: The steak is the one component with no built-in wheat; the sauce is the question. Everything around it uses soy.

items.en: Akari kaiseki — the seven appetisers, kudzu-dusted hamo with matsutake and junsai in clear soup, sea bream/bluefin/surf clam sashimi, salt-grilled Lake Biwa ayu, simmered winter melon with grilled chicken, and on through rice, red miso, three pickles and fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: 鱧葛打ち is dusted with kudzu starch (not wheat) before poaching — a genuinely wheat-free technique — but the dashi and the accompanying soy defeat it.

items.en: Suppon kaiseki — the house speciality, soft-shell turtle in six forms: two seasonal appetisers, the signature suppon hotpot, three sashimi, suppon chawanmushi with lily bulb and shiitake, suppon tempura with seasonal vegetables and tentsuyu, then suppon zosui rice porridge. Ten portions a day; book at least three days ahead
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: Tempura batter is wheat and 天だし is soy-based dashi. Turtle is prized in Japan as 滋養強壮 — a restorative.

items.en: Nagomi kaiseki — the full kaiseki with a main course you choose
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)

items.ja: 料理長おすすめ鱧と松茸の会席「禅」
items.en: Zen — the head chef's hamo-and-matsutake kaiseki, built around a matsutake dobin-mushi with pike conger and mitsuba
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: Hamo and matsutake together is the definitive Kyoto late-summer pairing.

items.ja: 京都牛、すっぽん鍋、伊勢海老の贅沢会席「桂」
items.en: Katsura — the top kaiseki: Kyoto beef, the suppon hotpot and spiny lobster
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)

items.en: Children's menu Hina — small dish, a children's plate of tuna sashimi, fried chicken, salmon roe and tamagoyaki with two simmered vegetables, rice, miso soup, seasonal ice cream
items.note: 若鶏の唐揚げ is wheat-floured and deep-fried.

items.en: Children's menu Mutsumi — small dish, appetiser assortment, two sashimi, fried prawn, five pieces of nigiri, miso soup, seasonal ice cream
items.note: 海老フライ is panko-breaded.

items.en: Sesame tofu — ground sesame set with kudzu starch, not soy; dense and faintly sweet
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Sesame and kudzu only in the block itself — no wheat and no animal product — but it is served under a dab of wasabi and a soy-based sauce. Ask for it plain and it becomes one of the few genuinely safe plates here.

items.en: Yuba sashimi — the skin lifted off simmering soy milk, eaten raw
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Soy milk and nothing else — the yuba itself is wheat-free and plant-based. It is dipped in soy sauce, which is not. Ask for salt instead.

items.en: Karasumi — salted, pressed and sun-dried grey mullet roe, sliced thin
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: One of Japan's three great 珍味 delicacies.

items.en: Konowata — salted fermented sea-cucumber entrails
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Another of the three great delicacies; intensely saline. Fish sauce and soy sometimes go into the cure.

items.en: Sea bream shiokara — the fish salted and fermented in its own guts
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers

items.en: Three delicacies on one plate
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers

items.en: Medium-fatty tuna, five pieces
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi
items.note: The fish is clean; the soy sauce is the wheat.

items.en: Sashimi assortment, three kinds
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi
items.note: Ask for salt or ponzu-free citrus if you avoid wheat — plain 醤油 is wheat by default in Japan.

items.en: Sashimi assortment, five kinds
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi

items.en: Silver cod marinated in miso and grilled — the house signature
items.section: 逸品メニュー 焼物 À la carte grilled
items.note: Saikyo miso marinade with sake and mirin; miso grain base undeclared. Treat as wheat.

items.en: Pomfret in miso, grilled
items.section: 逸品メニュー 焼物 À la carte grilled
items.note: Same marinade.

items.en: Nama-fu dengaku — fresh wheat-gluten cake grilled and topped with sweet miso
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: 麩 IS wheat gluten — this dish is literally made of it. The restaurant's own English calls it 'fresh gluten'. Never order this gluten-free; it is, however, a plant food and a Kyoto classic.

items.en: Chawanmushi — savoury steamed egg custard
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: The custard is egg and dashi, and the dashi is seasoned with 薄口醤油 — light soy sauce, which is still wheat. Bonito, so not vegan.

items.en: Clear soup with a poached fish dumpling
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: 真蒸 are bound with yamaimo and often wheat starch, and the broth is soy-seasoned dashi.

items.en: Kamo-manju — a dumpling of minced duck under a clear dashi sauce
items.section: 熊魚菴名物料理 House specialities

items.en: Kappa-maki — cucumber roll, the cheapest thing on the whole menu

items.ja: サービス寿司ランチ「由良川」
items.en: Yuragawa sushi lunch — appetiser, seven nigiri (toro, prawn, white fish, squid, lean tuna, shiny fish, ikura, uni) plus two futomaki, miso soup, dessert
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: The best-value way into this restaurant.

items.ja: おすすめ上握り寿司ランチ「八坂」
items.en: Yasaka premium nigiri lunch — appetiser and chawanmushi, nine nigiri including anago, plus a toro-tekka roll, miso soup, dessert
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 煮穴子 is simmered in soy; the chawanmushi is soy-seasoned too.

items.ja: おすすめちらし寿司ランチ「高瀬川」
items.en: Takasegawa chirashi lunch — a two-tier bowl: tuna, white fish, prawn, squid, shiny fish, scallop and tamago on top; simmered conger, ikura, kanpyo and shiitake below
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 干瓢 and 煮椎茸 are both simmered in soy and sugar; tamagoyaki usually carries mirin and soy.

items.ja: 上握り寿司ランチ「清水」
items.en: Kiyomizu premium nigiri lunch — appetiser and a small dish, then eleven pieces: otoro, chutoro, lean tuna, white fish, squid, prawn, shellfish, shiny fish, uni, ikura, simmered anago, a negitoro roll and tamago
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Not available in the private rooms — counter only.

items.ja: 料理長おすすめ寿司コース「味わい」
items.en: Ajiwai — the head chef's sushi course marking the hotel's 26th anniversary: appetiser, three sashimi, the signature Saikyo-miso silver cod, chawanmushi, then twelve selected nigiri including three cuts of bluefin
items.section: 寿司カウンター Sushi course

items.ja: 鉄板シーフードランチ「楓」
items.en: Kaede teppanyaki seafood lunch — today's soup, seasonal salad, grilled vegetables, sea bream and 'angel prawn' cooked on the plate in front of you, rice, pickles, miso soup, teppan dessert. Counter only, 12 seats, 11:30–14:30
items.price: ¥6,000（ガーリックライスに変更 +¥800／コーヒー・紅茶 +¥800）
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Teppan cooking uses a shared hot plate and the finishing sauce is normally soy and butter. Ask before the plate is seasoned, not after.

items.en: Gion teppanyaki lunch — today's fish as carpaccio, soup, seasonal salad, 80g of a rare lean cut of Yonezawa beef with grilled vegetables, then garlic rice or the chef's beef curry, pickles, Yamari miso soup, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 特製ビーフカレー — Japanese curry roux is a wheat-flour roux, always. Take the garlic rice instead, and ask about its soy. Supplements: today's seafood +¥2,000, foie gras +¥4,000, live abalone +¥6,000, spiny lobster +¥13,000.

items.ja: 活鮑付き鉄板焼きランチ「丹波」
items.romaji: Tanba — teppanyaki lunch with live abalone
items.en: Tanba teppanyaki lunch — carpaccio, soup, the chef's salad with house dressing, live abalone on the plate, 80g rare-cut Yonezawa beef, vegetables from around the country, garlic rice or beef curry, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Same curry-roux caveat.

items.ja: お手頃鉄板焼きディナー「大原」
items.en: Oohara teppanyaki dinner — carpaccio, soup, seasonal salad, 50g rare-cut Yonezawa beef with grilled vegetables, garlic rice or ume-and-baby-sardine rice, pickles, Yamari miso. Dessert with coffee or tea +¥2,500. Counter only, 17:00–22:00
items.section: 鉄板焼 夕食 Teppanyaki dinner (17:00–22:00)
items.note: 梅じゃこごはん is plum and dried sardine over rice — the most likely wheat-free carb here, but ask whether soy is used to season it.

items.ja: 本格鉄板焼きディナー「高雄」
items.en: Takao teppanyaki dinner — carpaccio, today's speciality, chef's salad, then a choice of 100g Yonezawa sirloin or 80g fillet with grilled vegetables, garlic rice or ume-jako rice
items.section: 鉄板焼 夕食 Teppanyaki dinner (17:00–22:00)
items.note: Teppanyaki dinners run up to ¥40,000 in the higher courses.

items.ja: 天婦羅ランチコース「明石」
items.en: Akashi tempura lunch — appetiser, two tiger prawns, two of today's fish, Japanese-style soup salad, lotus root, today's mushroom and one seasonal vegetable, a seasonal seafood kakiage, then your choice of tenbara-don, tendon or ten-cha, miso soup, pickles, dessert
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Wheat batter throughout; tendon sauce is soy. Weekend and holiday counter seatings are 11:30 or 13:30, 90 minutes; weekdays are untimed.

items.ja: 野菜中心ヘルシー天ぷらコース「にぎわい」
items.romaji: Nigiwai — yasai chushin healthy tempura course
items.en: Nigiwai — weekday-lunch-only vegetable-led tempura course with a welcome drink: seasonal appetiser, tempura of prawn, yuba and nama-fu, a seafood-broth vegetable soup salad, three seasonal vegetables, today's seafood kakiage, a rice bowl of your choice, pickles, miso, and freshly made kuzukiri for dessert
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 生麩 is wheat gluten and the batter is wheat — this course puts gluten in twice on purpose. The 葛切り dessert, by contrast, is pure kudzu starch. Welcome drink is beer, alcohol-free beer, cola, oolong or orange juice.

items.ja: おすすめ天婦羅ランチ「北野」
items.en: Kitano tempura lunch — appetiser, two tiger prawns, today's white fish and anago, soup salad, seasonal vegetables, sweet potato, asparagus and mushroom, a small-prawn-and-scallop kakiage, then salt-tendon, tendon or ten-cha
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 塩天丼 is tempura over rice with salt instead of sauce — the sauce comes off, the batter does not.

items.ja: お造り付き特別ランチ「振る舞い」
items.romaji: Furumai — special tempura lunch with sashimi
items.en: Furumai — tempura lunch with two sashimi added ahead of the prawns, white fish and anago
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)

items.ja: お勧め天婦羅コース「葵」
items.en: Aoi — the 26th-anniversary tempura course: early-summer appetiser, then wild tiger prawns, Seto Inland Sea hamo, young Lake Biwa ayu (or Edo-mae kisu or flathead once they run out), live black abalone, Hokkaido uni and large clam; a vegetable soup salad as a palate cleanser; Kyoto kamo-nasu, corn kakiage, asparagus and new lotus root
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター Tempura course

items.en: Rice set (rice, miso soup, pickles) ¥1,800; red miso soup alone ¥1,200
items.note: 赤出汁 is red miso — often 豆味噌 (soybean only, no grain) in this style, but the dashi is bonito.

items.ja: お抹茶とお菓子のセット
items.en: Matcha with a Japanese sweet
items.note: Matcha itself is fine but the 生菓子 served with it is a wheat or bean-paste confection; assume wheat. Ice cream is ¥1,000.

items.en: Room charges on top of the food: tatami rooms 紅梅 and 若紫 ¥22,000 each (4–10 people), both combined ¥33,000 (up to 30); private rooms 浮舟 ¥22,000 (4–12, with its own small garden), 梅枝 ¥11,000 (4–8), 朝顔 and 夕顔 ¥5,500 each (4–6, no door); the tea room 熊筌亭 ¥44,000, only bookable together with 浮舟
items.note: Private rooms take four people minimum. The à la carte list, and the Gion teppanyaki, Sagano tempura and Kiyomizu sushi courses, are NOT available in the rooms. 御祝い会席 and 法要会席 from ¥13,000 also exist.

items.ja: アレルギー対応について
items.en: The restaurant's own allergy statement: ingredients are checked against manufacturer information, but everything is cooked in one kitchen with shared equipment and washing machines, so trace allergen transfer is possible; the food is explicitly NOT a full allergy-safe menu, and they may decline service where a reaction would be severe
items.note: Recorded verbatim from the shop's own page because it is the single most useful line here: this kitchen does not claim allergen separation. Combined with soy sauce, dashi, tempura and 麩 running through nearly every course, a coeliac should not eat a course menu here without talking to the restaurant well in advance.

items.en: Small rice-bowl and Nikko tofu set — soy-milk tofu made with Nikko spring water, tofu dengaku with two misos (kinome and cherry-blossom), hijiki in mashed tofu dressing, ganmodoki simmered until it soaks, sesame tofu, today's small donburi, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. The cheapest full set
items.note: 白和え and 含ませ are simmered in bonito dashi with soy; がんもどき is deep-fried in a shared fryer; the dengaku miso's grain base is undeclared. Vegetable-heavy but neither vegan nor wheat-free.

items.ja: さごしの西京焼きと牛ステーキ御膳
items.romaji: sagoshi no saikyo-yaki to gyu steak gozen
items.en: Saikyo-grilled young Spanish mackerel and beef steak set — Nikko tofu, sesame tofu, Nikko yuba sashimi, the grilled fish, a beef steak, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: 西京焼き is a sweet-miso marinade with sake and mirin; the steak sauce is soy-based.

items.en: Sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, a three-part appetiser box (Nikko yuba sashimi, hijiki shira-ae, mizuna and abura-age in dashi), the sukiyaki pot, white rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: 割下, the sukiyaki broth, is soy sauce, mirin and sugar — wheat, unavoidably. Raw egg for dipping is standard.

items.en: Basket set — Nikko tofu, hijiki shira-ae, neri-dofu, mizuna and abura-age, simmered taro with grated daikon, Nikko yuba and tuna sashimi, beef steak, grilled fish, prawn-and-aubergine tempura, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. Twelve components
items.note: Tempura is wheat batter from a shared fryer.

items.en: Yuba and tuna mini-kaiseki — house tofu, house sesame tofu, tofu cured in Saikyo miso, Nikko yuba and tuna sashimi, tuna grilled on a ceramic plate with a Nikko tofu steak, prawn and vegetable tempura, yuba shumai, and yuba chazuke to finish
items.note: ゆば焼売 — shumai wrappers are wheat. Plus tempura batter and the chazuke broth's soy. The most interesting set here and one of the least gluten-free.

items.ja: 海老天丼とミニすき焼き御膳
items.en: Prawn tendon and mini-sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, simmered taro with grated daikon, a tendon of five prawns, a small sukiyaki pot, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: Tendon = wheat batter under a soy sauce; sukiyaki warishita = soy again.

items.en: Matsusaka beef sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, the three-part appetiser box, 90g of Matsusaka beef in the sukiyaki pot, white rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: Matsusaka is one of Japan's three great beef brands. Warishita is soy-based.

items.ja: ミニ鰻丼と冷やしうどん御膳
items.romaji: mini unadon to hiyashi udon gozen
items.en: Mini eel-rice and chilled udon set — chilled Nikko tofu, sesame tofu, assorted tempura, a small unagi donburi, cold udon, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: うどん is wheat noodle, the tsuyu is wheat soy sauce, the kabayaki glaze is soy, and the tempura is battered. Four wheat routes in one tray.

items.ja: 国産うな重と豆冨田楽御膳
items.romaji: kokusan unaju to tofu dengaku gozen
items.en: Domestic eel-box and tofu dengaku set — chilled Nikko tofu, two tofu dengaku (kinome miso and sakura miso), a lacquer box of domestic grilled eel over rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. The most expensive set
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: 蒲焼のたれ is soy, mirin and sugar reduced down — concentrated wheat.

items.romaji: hamo to katsuo no Kichiza bento
items.en: Kichiza bento of pike conger and bonito — twelve parts: chilled Nikko tofu, kumiage yuba, mizuna and abura-age in dashi, hijiki shira-ae, two tofu dengaku, tomato and cucumber in egg-yolk vinegar, seared bonito tataki, hamo tempura, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 吉座のおすすめ Kichiza recommendation
items.note: The bento to order if you want the widest spread for the money. 黄身酢 is egg yolk; hamo tempura is battered; katsuo tataki comes with ponzu, which is soy-based.

items.en: Nikko tofu — the house tofu, made from domestic soybeans and the famous spring water of Nikko; it appears in nearly every set, chilled as hiyayakko or as soy-milk tofu
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Soybeans, water and a coagulant — the block itself has no wheat and no animal product. What lands on it does: 冷奴 is served with soy sauce and usually katsuobushi flakes. Ask for it with salt and no bonito and this is the dish to eat here.

items.en: Sesame tofu — despite the name, ground sesame set with kudzu starch rather than soy
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Sesame and kudzu; no wheat in the block. Usually topped with wasabi and a soy-based sauce — ask them to leave the sauce off.

items.en: Nikko yuba sashimi — the skin skimmed from simmering soy milk, eaten raw. Nikko is one of the two towns in Japan famous for yuba, and its style is thicker and folded, unlike Kyoto's
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Soy milk only. The dipping soy sauce is the wheat; ask for salt.

items.ja: 豆冨田楽（木の芽味噌／桜味噌）
items.en: Tofu dengaku — tofu skewered and grilled under two misos: kinome, sharp with young sansho leaf, and sakura, made with cherry blossom
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: The miso's grain base is not declared — 麦味噌 would be barley — and dengaku miso is normally loosened with mirin and dashi. Ask.

items.en: Ganmodoki simmered until it soaks up the broth — deep-fried tofu patties studded with vegetable
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Deep-fried, then simmered in bonito dashi and soy. Plant-based in origin, but neither vegan nor wheat-free as served.

items.en: Hijiki seaweed dressed in mashed tofu
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: 白和え dressing is tofu, sesame and sugar — but the hijiki is simmered in dashi and soy first.

items.ja: 水菜と油揚げの煮浸し
items.en: Mizuna and fried tofu steeped in dashi
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: 煮浸し is by definition a bonito-dashi-and-soy steep.

items.ja: キリン一番搾り 生ビール
items.en: Kirin Ichibanshibori draft beer (bottled Kirin Lager, medium bottle, ¥979)
items.note: Barley beer — never gluten-free.

items.ja: 菊正宗 上撰 本醸造（兵庫）
items.en: Kikumasamune Josen honjozo sake from Hyogo — the classic dry Nada style
items.note: Sake is rice, water and koji — no wheat. Honjozo has a little distilled alcohol added. Sake is the sensible order if you are avoiding gluten in an izakaya.

items.ja: 澤乃井 奥多摩湧水仕込（東京）
items.en: Sawanoi, brewed with Okutama spring water — a Tokyo sake, from the mountains at the western end of the metropolis
items.note: Rice and water. Worth ordering as the local one.

items.ja: 銀盤 純米大吟醸（富山）
items.en: Ginban junmai daiginjo from Toyama — the top sake on the list, rice polished hard, nothing added
items.note: 純米 means rice and koji only, no added alcohol.

items.en: Kurokirishima sweet-potato shochu from Kagoshima — the best-selling imo-jochu in Japan (also 鬼火 and 一刻者 at ¥640, 晴耕雨読 ¥740, all sweet potato)
items.note: 芋焼酎 is distilled from sweet potato with RICE koji — no barley anywhere. This is the shochu shelf a coeliac can drink from.

items.en: Nikaido barley shochu from Oita — light and clean, the classic mugi-jochu
items.note: 麦 means BARLEY. Never order this one gluten-free — it is the single item on this drinks list most likely to catch someone out, sitting as it does among four sweet-potato shochus at the same price.

items.en: Kakutama plum wine ¥640; today's featured umeshu ¥740
items.note: Umeshu is plums steeped in a spirit base — and the base is sometimes 麦焼酎 (barley) rather than white liquor. Ask which.

items.en: Glass wine, red or white (bottle ¥3,140)
items.note: Grape wine — no grain.

items.en: Highball — whisky and soda
items.note: Whisky is a malted-barley distillate. The brief for this project treats highballs as never gluten-free.

items.en: Oolong-hai — shochu cut with oolong tea
items.note: Depends entirely on which shochu goes in — this house pours four sweet-potato shochus and one barley. Ask for 芋.

items.ja: カシスソーダ／カシスオレンジ／カシスウーロン
items.romaji: cassis soda / cassis orange / cassis oolong
items.en: Crème de cassis with soda, orange juice or oolong tea
items.note: Blackcurrant liqueur on a neutral base.

items.ja: 梅酒ソーダテイスト（ノンアルコール）
items.en: Alcohol-free plum-soda

items.ja: キリン グリーンズフリー（ノンアルコール）
items.en: Kirin Greens Free — alcohol-free beer
items.note: Alcohol-free but still a malt drink. Not gluten-free.

items.en: Orange juice, grapefruit juice, ginger ale, oolong tea — all ¥490
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: Note the tea offered is ウーロン茶 (oolong), not 麦茶 — oolong is a true tea leaf and carries no barley.

items.ja: アレルギー食材のコンタミネーションについて
items.en: The shop prints on every menu page: the same cooking utensils and washing machines are used across all dishes, so anyone who reacts to trace amounts should tell a member of staff
items.note: Recorded because it is the shop's own wording and it matters: a tofu restaurant looks like a safe haven, but the kitchen is shared with tempura, udon and sukiyaki. Speak to the staff before ordering — the notice explicitly invites it.
